AVIATION — TERMLY EXAM #14
====

GRADE: Grade 12
SUBJECT: AVIATION
TIME ALLOWED: 1 hour 30 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 50
EXAM BODY: KNEC / KCSE pathway

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. ICT stands for: (1 mark)
   A. Input Cable Tester
   B. Internal Cooking Timer
   C. Information and Communication Technology
   D. International Cricket Team

2. A computer’s main brain for processing is the: (1 mark)
   A. CPU
   B. Keyboard
   C. Monitor
   D. Speaker

3. When learning Aviation Security, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aviation Security.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Aviation Security.
   C. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Aviation Security.
   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aviation Security.

4. When learning Introduction to Simulated Flying, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Guess wiring or cutting steps for Introduction to Simulated Flying.
   B. Skip safety briefings for Introduction to Simulated Flying.

   D. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Introduction to Simulated Flying.

   D. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Stability.

6. Before using a sharp tool in a workshop, you should: (1 mark)
   A. Remove all guards
   B. Work alone with eyes closed
   C. Wear safety gear and follow instructions
   D. Run with the tool

7. When learning Cargo Handling, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

   D. Skip safety briefings for Career Opportunities in Aviation.

9. When learning Flight Safety, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)
   A. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Flight Safety.

   A. Follow procedure, use tools correctly, and check safety for Aircraft Systems.
   B. Leave sharp tools on the floor after Aircraft Systems.

11. Electricity safety rule: (1 mark)
   A. Ignore burnt cables
   B. Insert metal objects into sockets for fun
   C. Overload every socket
   D. Never touch live wires with wet hands

12. When learning Aviation Entrepreneurship, the safest correct step is: (1 mark)

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
16. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Basic Maintenance and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

17. In three clear sentences, explain Aircraft Related Drawing: Surface Development and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
